DESCRIPTION:

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39781881/43aa904ae520f25a6b5006a42bc1a872f838907e.png

Elf World Adventure 9: Summer Episode is a special summer edition of the popular H-game series in the anime and puzzle genre, where you will experience the hot sun, warm sea, and charming elf girls in light summer outfits. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a resort, enjoy relaxing music, and collect images that will give you a summer mood any time of the year.

The game will delight you not only with colorful and challenging puzzles but also with many achievements that you can use to decorate your Steam profile. Unlock all the illustrations, complete the gallery, and spend the perfect summer vacation in the company of beautiful elf girls.
GAMEPLAY:
In Elf World Adventure 9: Summer Episode, you will enjoy an exciting puzzle-solving process, where each completed puzzle unlocks a new illustration of beautiful elf girls. As you progress through the levels, you will fill up your gallery and enjoy all the unlocked images. Simple controls and an intuitive interface make the game accessible to everyone, while the summer atmosphere and relaxing music will help you forget about everyday worries.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39781881/f1b33c22e8ea8cd293198ca0dc45b64e49dd59ac.png

 Summer atmosphere: beaches, sunshine, and light outfits.
 Beautiful elf girls: unique anime-style designs.
 Relaxing music: the perfect soundtrack for your game.

 Many levels: challenge yourself with a variety of puzzles.

notes.title: Elf Adventure: The Lost Caslte - BUY NOW!!! WITH 20% DISCOUNT!!!
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39781881/852d3d3ac1c8ae83dd177a3d8ca402e4f439e3ca.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3221110/Elf_Adventure_The_Lost_Castle/

Game Description:

The elf Freilina was patrolling long-abandoned territories of the forces of evil when she noticed a mysterious castle with lights glowing in its windows. Who could have taken residence in this cursed place? Bandits? Demons? Or something far worse? Armed with a sword and a bow, she ventures inside to uncover the truth and cleanse the castle of its monstrous inhabitants.

Elf Adventure: The Lost Castle is an atmospheric anime-style adventure where players explore a dark and mysterious castle filled with traps, enemies, and valuable treasures. Navigate through vast halls and eerie corridors, battle goblins and their leaders, and discover hidden treasure chests containing unique illustrations of Freilina.

Game Features:


 Choose your combat style – Use a bow for ranged attacks or a sword for close combat.
 Explore the castle – Long corridors, hidden rooms, deadly traps.
 Battle goblins – Defeat enemies and face off against their leaders.
 Collect treasure chests – Find valuable rewards and gather all of Freilina's illustrations.
 Deep atmosphere – A dark fantasy setting full of mysteries and dangers.




Are you ready to cleanse the castle of evil and uncover its secrets?

notes.title: 👑 Lost Castle is calling you! Demo is now available — don’t miss it!
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39781881/3f0963009a9b0f82e84da2aaa300501bd7f86098.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3221110/Elf_Adventure_The_Lost_Castle/

DEMO VERSION — What Awaits You?

This demo is your first step into a fantasy adventure filled with danger, secrets, and the mysterious halls of an ancient castle. Please note: this is not the final version of the game. The full release will include significantly more content, expanded mechanics, and plenty of surprises we believe you’ll love.

In this demo, you’ll experience:


 Several carefully designed levels to explore
 Dynamic battles against goblins lurking in the shadows
 Hidden chests scattered throughout the castle
 Freilina’s lost illustrations waiting to be collected
 Simple and responsive controls
 A cozy yet mysterious atmosphere
 Captivating music that deepens the immersion


You’ll guide Freilina — a brave elf girl — as she fights enemies, explores ancient corridors, and recovers her illustrations.This is just the beginning. The final version will offer many more levels, new enemies, unique features, and gameplay mechanics that will elevate your experience to a whole new level.

At this stage, the demo will only support the English language. However, the full release will include additional language options, such as Korean, Japanese, Russian, and Simplified Chinese.
